title: Windows: file transfer to Mac now completes correctly
highlights: Windows: file transfer from Windows to Mac no longer incorrectly shows 'Failed' before completing. The Mac sends a preliminary acknowledgment when it receives a file offer; Windows was treating this as a final rejection and marking the transfer red. The transfer still landed on the Mac correctly, but the Windows UI showed a confusing flash of failure. Fixed by ignoring early nacks while streaming is still in progress.
